perksWithImages.name: Bloodhound
perksWithImages.description: Pools of Blood are brighter and last {Tunable.K02P02.ExtraTrackDuration}s longer.

perksWithImages.name: Coup de Grâce
perksWithImages.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn {Tunable.K22P03.TokensGainedPerGenerator} Tokens, up to {Tunable.K22P03.MaxTokens}.

Whenever you lunge-attack, spend {Tunable.K22P03.TokensSpentPerLunge} Token to make it {Tunable.K22P03.LungeExtraDuration%}% longer.

perksWithImages.name: Last Stand
perksWithImages.description: After hiding for {Tunable.S48P02.ActivationTime}s within the Killer's Terror Radius, when you fast-vault, once per trial, stun the Killer for {Tunable.S48P02.StunDuration}s if they are within {Tunable.S48P02.StunRange}m.

perksWithImages.name: ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR!
perksWithImages.description:
While idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to perform, empowering all Survivors within {Tunable.S49P02.PerformanceDistance}m for up to {Tunable.S49P02.PerformanceDuration}s. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. You get special Skill Checks during that time: while healing or repairing, basic Skill Checks are {Tunable.S49P02.SkillCheckIncrease%}% more likely to appear.

If you complete the performance, the effect ends after {Tunable.S49P02.EffectDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S49P02.Cooldown}s.
